verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair question for an error-tracking SaaS with client libraries and a CLI, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a way to opt out of vendor telemetry or usage tracking. References to 'telemetry' describe application data that users deliberately send to Honeybadger, not a privacy opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
